messages:
maria: Quick Q — trying to find traces for job-runner in prod. Most traces stop at 'enqueue' and the async worker spans don't show up in Tempo. Any recent sampling/collector changes? cc @aaron

aaron: Which service exactly? job-runner-prod? If you have a trace id we can look. We rolled a collector change yesterday to enable tail-based sampling for high-volume jobs.

maria: job-runner-prod. Example trace id I pulled from logs: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01. Logs in the worker show the same traceid, but I can't find child spans in Tempo.

sherin: Two quick checks: 1) are the worker spans propagating the same traceparent header from the enqueue request? 2) are workers using OTLP/HTTP directly or a sidecar agent? We switched some python workers to OTLP/HTTP client last month.

aaron: We bumped otel-collector to 0.76 and changed sampling config: head-based default rate=0.2 + tail-sampler for job services. If the sampling decision is made on the head and the worker spans arrive later, they can get dropped. Tail sampling should keep them, but the collector window matters.

eli: For python background threads make sure you explicitly propagate context. Example snippet: ```python
from opentelemetry import trace
span = trace.get_current_span()
ctx = span.get_span_context()
headers = {"traceparent": f"00-{ctx.trace_id:032x}-{ctx.span_id:016x}-01"}
# pass headers when calling the worker service
```

dave: Also confirm OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES and OTEL_SERVICE_NAME on the worker pods — if resource attrs differ we might treat spans as a different service and sampling policies may differ.

maria: Good points. Where's the Grafana panel that shows sampling rates and dropped traces? I couldn't find it.

aaron: Dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/obs/sampling-overview?orgId=1 — look for panels "sampler: head vs tail" and "dropped traces by service". There's also a table for collector sampling decisions.

sherin: If you want to debug quickly, set OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=always_on on one worker replica, run the job, and paste the trace id here — we'll see all spans.

maria: Also, the tail-sampler window is set to 30s right now — many jobs finish ~45s. Should that be extended?

aaron: Yeah, for job-runner we should bump it to 60s. I'll open a config rollout for the collector and add a temporary exception for job-runner.

devops-bot: deploy-job-runner-sampling-config rolled to prod by @aaron — config change id cfg-2026-137 

maria: Thanks — I'll flip the debug sampler, run a test job, and paste the trace id if it still looks wrong. Appreciate the quick help!
